'''Amin-Le''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She resided at the [[Shrine of Healing]], where she held watch over the [[Vitalicron/Legends|Vitalicrons]]. Around [[3640 BBY]], she was approached by [[Cipher Nine]] who asked for information concerning [[Albathius]], also known as the Shining Man.
